purpose: Cleanup wave ordering with dependency rationale

default_order.name: Security / Credential Risk
default_order.reason: Must run first — an expired production credential is a P0 risk that takes priority over all other cleanup

default_order.name: License Rationalization
default_order.reason: Informed by FD-004/006 (which accounts are no longer needed after Team archival). No removals without FD answers.

default_order.name: Service Account Modernization
default_order.reason: Identity cleanup should precede collaboration/mailbox changes to avoid permission breaks

default_order.name: Mailbox Rationalization
default_order.reason: Mailboxes must be confirmed before Teams archival — some Teams' mailboxes (Sales, Projects) are separate from shared mailboxes

default_order.name: Teams / Group Rationalization
default_order.reason: Teams contain SharePoint sites — Teams archival must coordinate with SharePoint alignment. Teams should archive after their SharePoint content is preserved.
default_order.after: Wave 6 SharePoint preservation steps complete for affected sites; requires FD-004, FD-006

default_order.name: SharePoint Alignment
default_order.reason: Document preservation before Team archival ensures no content is lost when Teams/sites are archived
default_order.after: Wave 3; requires FD-001, FD-002, FD-003. Feeds Wave 5.

default_order.name: App Registration Retirement
default_order.reason: App identities should be retired after the workloads they serve are confirmed decommissioned. Dependency audit must complete first.

default_order.name: Repository Archive
default_order.reason: No action warranted. Would follow all other waves if candidates were identified.

adjusted_order_rationale.wave_6_before_wave_5: Wave 6 SharePoint content preservation must complete before Wave 5 Team archival for the same sites (sales, projects, foundation_comm if consolidating). This is a dependency, not a bug in the ordering.
